segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, yeah, thanks for making time. I had us down for 25 minutes to walk through the 60-seat subscription and the June go-live. Does that still work?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, works. Main thing is we need the team live by June 17. Our current tool renews July 1, so I don’t want overlap if we can avoid it.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. For 60 seats on the business plan, annual term starting June 17, the price is $42,600. That includes the standard onboarding package, two admin trainings, and email support.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. We may add 10 more seats in August for the field managers. Do we have to amend the whole contract for that?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: No, not the whole thing. The order form has an add-seat provision. If you add 10 seats on August 5, they’d be prorated through June 16 next year, so roughly $5,250 for those seats.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That’s fine. On invoicing, we need net 30, and the invoice has to reference PO 48173. Can you include that?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. Net 30 is standard for this package, and I’ll put PO 48173 on the order form so billing has it on the first invoice.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. One other thing: legal asked if the data processing terms are already attached or if they come separately.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: They’re attached as an exhibit to the agreement. Same version we reviewed last week, dated May 9. No changes from that redline.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. If you send the final today, I can route it for signature tomorrow morning.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: I’ll send it by 2 p.m. Eastern. Once it’s signed, we can schedule kickoff for May 29 and target admin training on June 4 and June 6.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That timeline works. Send it over and I’ll keep an eye out.
